lah.meaning: the all-purpose emphasis particle. softens, insists, ends arguments.

leh.meaning: particle for gentle pleading or pointing something out. 'very hard leh'

lor.meaning: particle of resignation. that's just how it is lor.

sia.meaning: exclamation particle for emphasis or envy. 'so lucky sia'

hor.meaning: particle seeking agreement. 'very hot today hor'

mah.meaning: particle stating the obvious. 'i told you mah'

wor.meaning: particle relaying surprise or someone else's words.

aiyo.meaning: exclamation of dismay or sympathy, from tamil/chinese.

alamak.meaning: oh no! from malay. classic facepalm word.

walao.meaning: exclamation of disbelief. printable version of a stronger phrase.

walau.meaning: same as walao — disbelief, wow, cannot believe it.

wah.meaning: wow. the start of many singaporean sentences.

chey.meaning: is that all? expresses being unimpressed.

shiok.meaning: extremely satisfying. food, aircon, naps — all can be shiok.

paiseh.meaning: embarrassed / shy, from hokkien. 'paiseh, i'm late'

kiasu.meaning: afraid to lose out. the national condition.

kiasi.meaning: afraid to die — overly cautious. cousin of kiasu.

atas.meaning: high-class, posh, from malay 'above'. atas cafe, atas taste.

sian.meaning: bored, weary, over it. the monday feeling.

blur.meaning: clueless, slow to catch on. 'blur like sotong'

steady.meaning: reliable, cool, well done. also: dating ('they steady liao').

jialat.meaning: in serious trouble, from hokkien 'sapping strength'. very bad.

cheem.meaning: deep, profound, hard to understand. 'wah so cheem'

ulu.meaning: remote, out of the way. anywhere without an mrt station.

hosay.meaning: good, all set, from hokkien. 'hosay liao!'

swee.meaning: beautiful, perfect, nicely done. from hokkien.

song.meaning: satisfying, feels great. like shiok's cousin.

suay.meaning: unlucky. stepped in a puddle? suay.

huat.meaning: to prosper. shouted while tossing yusheng at cny.

garang.meaning: fierce, gung-ho, from malay. charges in first.

kaypoh.meaning: nosy, busybody. your neighbour who knows everything.

gian.meaning: craving, itching for it. 'gian for prata'

buay.meaning: cannot / not able, from hokkien. 'buay tahan'

boliao.meaning: bored to the point of doing nonsense. idle mischief.

sabo.meaning: to sabotage someone, usually into extra work. 'kena sabo'

keng.meaning: to malinger, fake illness to escape work. army classic.

chop.meaning: a stamp or seal; to stamp. 'chop your passport'

chope.meaning: to reserve a seat, traditionally with a tissue packet.

cabut.meaning: to run off / escape, from malay. 'time to cabut'

gostan.meaning: to reverse (a vehicle), from 'go astern'. nautical heritage.

lepak.meaning: to chill, hang out doing nothing, from malay.

jio.meaning: to invite someone along. 'jio me leh'

bojio.meaning: the accusation: you didn't invite me. gravest of offences.

lobang.meaning: an opportunity or good deal, from malay 'hole'. got lobang?

arrow.meaning: to assign an unwanted task to someone. 'i kena arrowed'

agak.meaning: to estimate roughly, from malay. 'agak agak can already'

papaya.meaning: the second half of 'yaya papaya' — a show-off.

terok.meaning: terrible, demanding, difficult. from malay teruk.

power.meaning: amazing, impressive. 'this nasi lemak power sia'

gila.meaning: crazy, from malay. interchangeable with siao.

dulan.meaning: annoyed, fed up. politer than its hokkien origin deserves.

kena.meaning: to get hit by something bad, from malay. 'kena scolding'

tio.meaning: to get / be struck by, hokkien cousin of kena. 'tio saman'

tahan.meaning: to endure, from malay. 'cannot tahan' = at my limit.

chup.meaning: hold on / wait a moment. also to reserve, like chope.

makan.meaning: to eat; food, from malay. the national pastime.

tapao.meaning: to take away food, from cantonese. same as dabao.

dabao.meaning: to take away food, from mandarin/cantonese. 'dabao one chicken rice'

chiong.meaning: to charge ahead, rush at full speed. 'chiong for the deadline'

whack.meaning: to go all in, hit hard. 'just whack' = just do it.

tekan.meaning: to press / punish hard, from malay. army pt flashbacks.

ponteng.meaning: to play truant, from malay. skip school or work.

pon.meaning: short for ponteng — to skip class.

kope.meaning: to pilfer, take without asking. 'who kope my pen?'

lelong.meaning: cheap sale / auction, from malay. 'lelong lelong!'

izzit.meaning: 'is it?' — the universal singlish question tag.

sekali.meaning: what if / suddenly, from malay. 'sekali rain how?'

tompang.meaning: to hitch a ride or ask a favour delivery, from malay.

kentang.meaning: potato, from malay — a westernised local who can't speak mother tongue.

belanja.meaning: to treat someone, from malay. 'i belanja you kopi'

hantam.meaning: to whack / do it rough-and-ready, from malay. 'just hantam'

chao.meaning: smelly / awful prefix, from hokkien. 'chao keng' = shameless malingerer.

chincai.meaning: anyhow, casually, whatever works. from hokkien.

wayang.meaning: putting on a show, acting hardworking for the boss. from malay 'theatre'.

zhng.meaning: to pimp up / modify. 'zhng my car'

kayu.meaning: wooden, blockheaded, from malay. shouted at referees.

potong.meaning: to cut, from malay. potong jalan = steal someone's date.

jiak.meaning: to eat, from hokkien. 'jiak liao bee' = freeloader.

loti.meaning: bread, from malay roti said the singlish way.

kopi.meaning: coffee, kopitiam style — with condensed milk unless you say otherwise.

teh.meaning: tea with condensed milk. the kopi order alphabet starts here.

peng.meaning: iced, from hokkien. kopi peng, teh peng, milo peng.

kosong.meaning: zero / plain, from malay — no sugar, no milk.

gau.meaning: extra thick / strong, from hokkien. kopi gau for hard mornings.

siew.meaning: less, from hokkien. siew dai = less sweet.

dai.meaning: the 'dai' in siew dai — less sweet, kopitiam dialect.

milo.meaning: the national chocolate malt drink. see also: milo dinosaur.

dinosaur.meaning: milo dinosaur — iced milo buried under a mound of milo powder.

bandung.meaning: rose syrup with milk, bright pink, sweeter than it looks.

tarik.meaning: pulled, from malay. teh tarik is poured between mugs till frothy.

yuanyang.meaning: kopi and teh mixed together. why choose?

kaya.meaning: coconut-egg jam. on toast with butter, national breakfast.

paynow.meaning: instant bank transfer by mobile number. how all group bills get settled.

paylah.meaning: dbs's everyday payment app. 'paylah me' is a verb now.

paywave.meaning: contactless card tap at the till. 'paywave can?'

grabpay.meaning: grab's in-app wallet — rides, food, and the kopitiam that takes it.

ezlink.meaning: the tap-in tap-out transit card generations grew up topping up.

simplygo.meaning: tap your bank card straight onto the bus and mrt.

nets.meaning: the og local debit payment network at every checkout.

giro.meaning: automatic bank deduction — how bills quietly pay themselves.

singpass.meaning: national digital id. one login for everything government.

atm.meaning: cash machine. queue snakes at cny for new notes.

cpf.meaning: central provident fund — compulsory savings for retirement, housing, healthcare.

medisave.meaning: the cpf account earmarked for hospital bills and approved insurance.

gst.meaning: goods and services tax. the percentage everyone can quote.

nric.meaning: national identity card — the number you memorise for life.

coe.meaning: certificate of entitlement — the right to own a car, often pricier than the car.

erp.meaning: electronic road pricing — the gantry that charges you for driving at peak hour.

cdc.meaning: community development council — of cdc voucher fame.

voucher.meaning: usually the cdc kind — free spending at hawkers and heartland shops.

bto.meaning: build-to-order hdb flat. apply, ballot, then wait years for keys.

hdb.meaning: housing & development board — public housing, home to ~80% of singapore.

resale.meaning: a second-hand hdb flat — no ballot, no wait, higher price.

condo.meaning: private condominium. the upgrade dream with the pool and gym.

ec.meaning: executive condominium — half public, half private, fully oversubscribed.

reno.meaning: renovation. the six months between getting keys and moving in.

aircon.meaning: air-conditioning — called the greatest invention by lee kuan yew.

mrt.meaning: mass rapid transit — the train network that structures the whole island.

lrt.meaning: light rail transit — the little loop trains around punggol, sengkang, bukit panjang.

grab.meaning: the ride-hailing and delivery super-app of southeast asia.

gojek.meaning: the other ride-hailing app, from indonesia.

tada.meaning: ride-hailing app locals open when grab surges.

smrt.meaning: the operator of trains and buses; the letters everyone knows.

carpark.meaning: where the car sleeps. season parking is a whole economy.

ns.meaning: national service — two years every singaporean son serves.

nsf.meaning: full-time national serviceman — currently serving his two years.

ord.meaning: operationally ready date — the day ns ends. 'ord loh!'

ippt.meaning: individual physical proficiency test — push-ups, sit-ups, 2.4km run.

bmt.meaning: basic military training on pulau tekong. where enlistment begins.

encik.meaning: how you address a warrant officer. respect, from malay 'mister'.

botak.meaning: bald, from malay — the enlistment haircut.

reservist.meaning: the yearly call-back to camp, for a decade after ord.

psle.meaning: primary school leaving examination — the exam at twelve the whole family sits.

olevels.meaning: o-level exams at sixteen — gateway to jc, poly, or ite.

alevels.meaning: a-level exams — the jc endgame before uni.

poly.meaning: polytechnic — diploma route, no uniform, real-world projects.

jc.meaning: junior college — two years of mugging for the a-levels.

uni.meaning: university. the question every relative asks about at cny.

smu.meaning: singapore management university — the city-campus one.

ite.meaning: institute of technical education — hands-on skills route.

cca.meaning: co-curricular activity — the after-school thing that eats saturdays.

tuition.meaning: after-school classes on top of school. a billion-dollar industry.

mug.meaning: to study intensely. 'mugging at the library'

mlbb.meaning: mobile legends: bang bang — the moba half the school queues in.

dota.meaning: defense of the ancients — the lan-shop classic that raised a generation.

valorant.meaning: riot's tactical shooter — the aim-training excuse.

genshin.meaning: genshin impact — the gacha rpg that empties wallets politely.

ranked.meaning: competitive matchmaking. where friendships are tested.

noob.meaning: a beginner, or anyone playing worse than you.

gg.meaning: good game — also singlish for 'it's over / we're doomed'. 'gg liao'

afk.meaning: away from keyboard — the teammate who vanished mid-match.

buff.meaning: a power-up; to make stronger. opposite of nerf.

nerf.meaning: to weaken something in a game update. cue forum outrage.

carry.meaning: to win the game for your whole team. 'i carry you lah'

toxic.meaning: hostile in-game behaviour. mute and report.

shopee.meaning: the orange shopping app with the 9.9 sales and the jingle.

lazada.meaning: the other big online mall of southeast asia.

carousell.meaning: local marketplace app. 'is this still available?'

taobao.meaning: china's everything-store — where the reno furniture secretly came from.

telegram.meaning: the messaging app where all the deal channels and class chats live.

whatsapp.meaning: where the family group chat forwards good-morning pictures.

ntuc.meaning: shorthand for the fairprice supermarket downstairs.

fairprice.meaning: the national supermarket chain — 'go ntuc' means come here.

kopitiam.meaning: traditional coffee shop, from malay kopi + hokkien tiam (shop).

hawker.meaning: the hawker centre — unesco-listed food paradise under one roof.

foodcourt.meaning: the air-conditioned, slightly pricier cousin of the hawker centre.

sentosa.meaning: the resort island. 'so expensive one' — everyone, every visit.

changi.meaning: the airport that keeps winning world's best. also a neighbourhood.

jewel.meaning: the mall at changi with the indoor waterfall everyone photographs.

orchard.meaning: the shopping street. crowded every weekend without fail.

bugis.meaning: street-market shopping district, cheap finds and crowds.

merlion.meaning: half lion half fish, spouting water at marina bay. the mascot.

jb.meaning: johor bahru — across the causeway for cheap petrol, food, groceries.

causeway.meaning: the bridge to jb. legendary jams on long weekends.

batam.meaning: the indonesian island a ferry ride away — seafood and spa weekend.

ndp.meaning: national day parade, every 9 august. fighter jets and fireworks.

majulah.meaning: 'onward', from malay — majulah singapura, the national anthem.

angbao.meaning: red packet of money, given at cny and weddings.

4d.meaning: the four-digit lottery. uncle's weekly ritual.

toto.meaning: the number-draw lottery. queues at outlets when the prize snowballs.

chalet.meaning: a rented bungalow for bbq gatherings, usually in pasir ris.

staycay.meaning: staycation — a hotel weekend without leaving the island.

durian.meaning: the king of fruits. banned on the mrt, adored everywhere else.
